welcome.title: Welcome to TextMate!
welcome.content: TextMate is an AI-based text editor that helps you improve your text. All data is processed on local servers of IT BS. You can process special personal data and data that are subject to professional confidentiality (Erhöhter Schutzbedarf) with TextMate. I will now show you the main functions of TextMate.

functions.title: TextMate has two main functions
functions.content: Here you can switch between the two main functions: Rewrite to leverage AI for text enhancement, and Review to check your text against guideline documents.

language.title: Language Selection
language.content: Choose the language for your text. This helps the AI tools provide better results for the selected language.

dictionary.title: Personal Dictionary
dictionary.content: Add words to your personal dictionary. This is useful for specialized terminology, names, or words that you want to keep consistent.

editor.title: Text Editor
editor.content: This is where you write and edit your text. The editor provides various tools to enhance and transform your writing.

wordCount.title: Text Statistics
wordCount.content: View detailed information about your text including word count, character count, and Flesch reading ease score. Click on these statistics to see more details about your text's readability.

textEditorToolpanel.title: Text Editor Tools
textEditorToolpanel.content: Here you can undo or redo your changes. Additionally, you can upload a document, which will be converted to text and opened in the editor.

rewriteOptions.title: Rewrite Options
rewriteOptions.content: Define here how your text should be rewritten. Customize writing style, target audience, intent, and medium to suit your needs.

rewriteToolpanel.title: Accept or Reject Rewrite Actions
rewriteToolpanel.content: Here you can undo the last rewrite action or accept all changes.

retry.title: Retry an Action
retry.content: Not happy with the result? Click here to discard the suggestion and run the same action again on your original text.

rewrite.title: AI Text Rewriting
rewrite.content: When a text action is executed, the changes appear here. Click on a change to undo it or on the checkmark below to accept all changes.

advisor.title: Document Advisor
advisor.content: Select a policy according to which you want to check your document. The document advisor will show you the violations it found against the selected policy.

quickActions.title: Rewrite Actions
quickActions.content: Perform text actions such as summaries or rewrites. Select an action to apply it to your text.

customQuickAction.title: Custom Rewrite Instructions
customQuickAction.content: Enter your custom rewrite instructions here to rewrite your text according to your wishes. This is useful when you have special requirements that are not included in the standard actions.
customQuickAction.contentWithLink: Enter your custom rewrite instructions here to rewrite your text according to your wishes. This is useful when you have special requirements that are not included in the standard actions. For tips on writing effective prompts, visit the {link}.

conclusion.title: That's it!
conclusion.content: You are now ready to make full use of TextMate. Feel free to restart the tour if you forget something. Have fun writing!
